title: Wine Tasting on Ile d'Orleans
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Discover Île d’Orléans wine country with Quebec Bus Tour’s signature small-group experience, just 15 minutes from Old Quebec. Visit three selected vineyards — Domaine Sainte-Famille, Vignoble du Mitan, and Isle de Bacchus — and enjoy guided tastings of local wines. Learn about Quebec’s winemaking traditions from a passionate bilingual guide while taking in scenic views of the St. Lawrence River and Montmorency Falls. A relaxed, immersive experience and one of the best things to do near Quebec City.
